note: The High unprotected `trunk` path was judged overstated: `docker.yaml` runs on every push but its Docker Hub login, signing and push steps carry `if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')`, so a push to the branch reaches no secret, Low (the tag push is a separate insider entry); the High `geomys/sandboxed-step@v1.2.2` path was judged overstated: a mutable third-party action in a CI job with no secret and no write token (or only an assumed one) gives code execution on a runner, Medium at most. Read against the spec: on a push to `trunk` the Docker Hub login, the signing and `push:` are all tag-gated, the other two workflows hold no secret, and what is left, `id-token: write`, is not one of the escalations an unprotected-branch path is kept for (section 8.2: a secret, a publish or deploy, a release, an environment), so the trunk entry starts no path; once the tag-gated secrets stop counting, an `id-token`-only path would still wait on the token-scope defect of the unprotected branch.

ceilings.pending: secrets referenced only in steps under `if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')` are still counted for a push to the branch, where those steps never run.
